intent: Make the surface work at the sizes it will actually be used at.
moves: Design the narrow view first, then let space earn the wider one.
Give every touch target at least 44px, including its padding.
Reflow columns to rows rather than shrinking them below their comfortable measure.
Move hover-only affordances to something always visible on touch.
Reduce section spacing on small screens, but never reduce text below its floor.
avoid: Horizontal scrolling on a page that is not a table or a carousel.
Hiding content at narrow widths that the narrow user still needs.
Scaling one desktop layout down and calling it responsive.
